TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION: HYPERTEXT TRANSFER PROTOCOL (HTTP/3)
HTTP/3 is the upcoming major revision of the HTTP network protocol.
Unlike earlier versions which relied on TCP, HTTP/3 utilizes QUIC, a multiplexed transport protocol over UDP.
QUIC eliminates head-of-line blocking and provides reduced connection establishment latency.
All connections are encrypted by default using TLS 1.3 cryptographic primitives.
